name: AU-510
title: FlexRadio AU-510
summary: Headless Aurora: 500 W HF / 200 W 6m single-SCU SDR with built-in ATU and AC PSU; needs PC/iPad/Maestro.

f.band_scope: panadapter + waterfall (2 pans, up to 7 MHz each, client-side)
special: 500 W PEP HF / 200 W 6m integrated PA
requires: PC/Mac/iPad running SmartSDR or a Maestro controller (no front panel)

gotchas: Headless: needs a PC/Mac/iPad (SmartSDR) or Maestro — fri-au-510m adds the front panel (+$1,150)
Single SCU / 2 slices — no diversity/SO2R; fri-au-520 has 2 SCUs (+$2,400)
500 W out: every downstream item (coax switch, balun, feedline, antenna traps, external tuner) must be ≥500 W PEP rated — 100 W baluns/tuners will fail
500 W needs a proper FCC RF-exposure evaluation for your antenna/distances; 60m is capped at 100 W ERP — run reduced power there
Don't drive an external amp from the 500 W output — use the low-level exciter/transverter port or turn power down
vs fri-flex-8400atu ($2,849) + separate 500 W amp/PSU: Aurora is one box, AC-powered, but $3,350 more
best_for: more punch without a separate amp

pairs.id: Windows PC / Mac / iPad running SmartSDR

pairs.why: knobs+screen alternative to a PC for headless units
no hand mic included with Aurora
